title: F5 skeptic: post-null-extraction widths 10 and 17 (rival to width-21)
hypothesis_summary: Skeptic counterpart to F5-51/52. Project memory (memory/width21_bigram_73char.md, 2026-03-15) shows that the width-21 anomaly DISAPPEARS after null extraction, while NEW high-significance vertical-bigram anomalies appear at widths 10 (p=0.006) and 17 (p=0.008) on the null-extracted CT73. If the bigram structure is genuine and stego-mediated, F5-53 should match or beat F5-51/52. If F5-51/52 win, the raw-CT interpretation is preferred. Tests width-10 and width-17 columnar with sub layers.

caveats: SKEPTIC framing relative to F5-51/52 (raw-CT widths).
The bridge compiler operates on raw CT, so this pack tests widths 10/17 ON RAW CT — not on CT73. The post-null finding is the EVIDENCE for 10/17 as candidate widths, not the evaluation surface.
